content:
maria (product): quick sync — the customer pilot (Acme) wants private deployment + KMS + dedicated capacity by end of next month. we need to map blockers across runtime/infra/security. who can own each piece?

sam (eng-runtime): i can own the runtime changes (model pinning + canary fallback). main risk is kv-cache persistence for private envs. need infra help for storage and network.

li (infra): noted. for private we need a VPC peering playbook and a capacity reservation flow. timeline depends on GPU pool availability. can we flatten scope?

maria (product): can we split the launch into 1) SAAS private control plane + onboarding, 2) dedicated capacity in customer region? customer will accept two-phase if we hit security certs first.

jordan (security): we must validate KMS integration and attestation for their HSM. also need an audit log retention plan. i can do threat model review this week but will need access to their certs.

anika (customer-success): Acme is flexible on staged rollout. priority is data isolation and auditability. also they need SLOs: <100ms tail for embeddings queries.

sam (eng-runtime): 100ms tail for embeddings on dedicated GPU is tight with current batching defaults. we can tune batching and KV caching. action: i'll prototype quantized model path and measure.

li (infra): action from infra: estimate 2 weeks to wire VPC peering + reserved GPU pool (best-case), add 1 week for infra-onboarding docs. need exact CIDR and contact.

jordan (security): action: I'll run pre-audit checklist. need KMS endpoint + HSM handshake doc. ETA 5 days once we have contact.

maria (product): OK action list so far. propose schedule: week 1: security pre-audit + infra CIDR; week 2: infra peering + GPU reservation; week 3: runtime prototype + KMS integration; week 4: canary + perf runbook.

sam (eng-runtime): realistic. but call out rollback policy for canary: fallback to hosted model variant if private path fails. we should add automatic routing policy in router config.

li (infra): agree on routing fallback. infra will add a temporary NAT/egress rule for telemetry during onboarding. please confirm compliance with security.

jordan (security): telemetry egress needs whitelisting and encryption-in-transit. add to checklist: explicit allowlist + signed certs.

anika (customer-success): i'll collect Acme contacts and KMS details today and share. they also asked for a runbook doc for their ops team.

maria (product): perfect. i'll compile a one-pager and an MVP acceptance criteria list: 
- private control plane reachable from their VPC
- KMS integrated and validated
- reserved GPU pool online and serving at target SLOs
- canary traffic <5% initial, rollback policy in place
- audit logs forwarding to their SIEM

sam (eng-runtime): adding one note: we need a perf gate for embeddings (p99 under 200ms during canary) before shifting to 25% traffic.

jordan (security): noted. also require SOC doc and encryption key rotation plan before prod.

li (infra): i'll put resource request into the next capacity meeting. if approved, infra ETA moves up.

maria (product): thanks all. can everyone react to this thread with :thumbsup: if they agree to owners and the proposed timeline, or say otherwise. i'll convert to a project card after approvals.

devops-bot: build/capacity-check started: GPU-pool-allocator v2 triggered by @li. status: queued.

sam (eng-runtime): :thumbsup:

li (infra): :thumbsup: will follow up with CIDR details in DM.

jordan (security): :thumbsup: starting checklist now.

anika (customer-success): :thumbsup: will share contact + docs today.

maria (product): great — i'll file the card and ping infra for the capacity meeting slot. thanks everyone :rocket:
